evidence: finish_adjust_value_mutation invokes finish_unchanged_adjust_value only for UiPropertyMutationStatus::Unchanged. That function emits accessibility_property_changed:<property>:<dirty> and appends the same Unchanged binding report, while no ValueChanged event is emitted. Neighbor expanded/value result owners correctly use accessibility_property_unchanged for their unchanged paths. A slider at maximum receiving Increment takes this branch through surface range mutation.
impact_or_question: Action diagnostic falsely reports a change for a no-op slider adjustment; diagnostic consumers see contradictory change text vs unchanged binding receipt.
next_action: Use an unchanged diagnostic for this branch and add a slider-at-boundary action assertion covering both note and binding status.
